LanguageData.MA_NoMatch: Nothing matches. Search also looks at mod names.
LanguageData.MA_FavEmpty: No favorites yet – hover a building and click the ★ in its corner.
LanguageData.MA_InfoHint: Hover a building to see what it is, what it costs and which mod it comes from.
LanguageData.MA_Enabled_Desc: Off = the game's own architect menu. Turn off Better Architect or other architect menus – only one can be used.
LanguageData.MA_ShowInfo_Desc: What the hovered building is, its cost and its mod.
LanguageData.MA_ByMod_Desc: Sub-categories by the mod the buildings come from instead of by what they are.
LanguageData.MA_ShowLocked_Desc: Also show buildings that still need research (greyed out). Click one to open research.
LanguageData.MA_ResizeTip: Drag: the top edge = height, the right edge = width, this corner = both.
LanguageData.MA_Cols_Desc: How many columns the categories on the left use (1, 2 or 3). Click to change.
LanguageData.MA_Grouped_Desc: Instead of every category of every mod, the buildings are sorted into a few main folders by what they are (a table from any mod goes to Furniture). Things from mods are shown below the base game ones. Folders with nothing to build stay hidden until something gets unlocked.
LanguageData.MA_GroupedShort_Desc: Sort everything into a few main folders by what it is. Off: the game's and mods' own categories.
LanguageData.MA_Afford_Desc: Show only what there is enough material for right now.
